title: Pinned exact five-term comparison for perfect Hom on a two-open cover
statement: Let I be a directed preordered set, R:I→CommRing a diagram, c a colimit cocone, i∈I, and s₀:X→Spec(R_i) a quasi-compact, quasi-separated, locally finitely presented scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Let U,V be opens of X, with U compact and V affine. Assume PerfectHomContinuityOn [def-pc-perfect-hom-continuity-on] for U,V,U∩V. Fix an open immersion t:Y→X with range U∪V, its structure map s=t≫s₀ with the same morphism properties, and perfect complexes P,Q on Y [def-pc-perfect-complex]. All scheme-derived categories exist [def-pc-derived-category], as do the localized module-site derived categories on Y. There exist a functor H from the tail above i to sets in universe max u w, a colimit cocone d, and equivalences ident_j identifying H(j) with the stage derived Hom sets. These equivalences identify H transitions with perfectStageMap [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport]. There are exact five-term rows A,B of abelian groups, a morphism φ:A→B, equivalences a:d.pt≃A₂ and b:B₂≃Hom(P_limit,Q_limit), and isomorphism components φ₀,φ₁,φ₃,φ₄. For every stage representative f, b(φ₂(a(d.ι_j(f))))=perfectLimitMap(ident_j(f)). The theorem does not assert invertibility of φ₂ or continuity on the union.

proof.text: Construct H,d,ident with canonical stage transitions using perfect_hom_stage_colimit. This does not use the cover or continuity.
Apply perfect_hom_mayerVietoris_local_rows to the supplied stage colimit. Obtain exact A,B, the morphism φ, central equivalences and pinning, and four local-map presentations.

Apply PerfectHomLocalMap.bijective to each neighboring map using hcontU,hcontV,hcontUV. Convert each bijective abelian-group homomorphism to an isomorphism with ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective. Package these isomorphisms together with the unchanged central pinning and exactness witnesses.

theorem perfect_hom_mayerVietoris_comparison
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (X : Scheme.{u}) (s₀ : X ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s₀] [QuasiCompact s₀] [QuasiSeparated s₀]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    (U V : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (hcontU : PerfectHomContinuityOn R c i X s₀ U)
    (hcontV : PerfectHomContinuityOn R c i X s₀ V)
    (hcontUV : PerfectHomContinuityOn R c i X s₀ (U ⊓ V))
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (t : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion t]
    (ht : t.opensRange = U ⊔ V)
    (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) (hs : s = t ≫ s₀)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s] [QuasiCompact s] [QuasiSeparated s]
    [∀ W : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over W))]
    (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hP : Y.IsPerfect P) (hQ : Y.IsPerfect Q) :
    ∃ (H : Set.Ici i ⥤ Type (max u w)) (d : Cocone H),
      Nonempty (IsColimit d) ∧
      ∃ (ident : ∀ j : Set.Ici i, H.obj j ≃
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj P ⟶
           (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj Q)),
        (∀ (j k : Set.Ici i) (hjk : j ≤ k) (f : H.obj j),
          ident k (H.map (homOfLE hjk) f) =
            perfectStageMap R s j.property hjk (ident j f)) ∧
        ∃ (A B : ComposableArrows AddCommGrpCat.{max u w} 4) (φ : A ⟶ B)
          (a : d.pt ≃ A.obj' 2)
          (b : B.obj' 2 ≃
            ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj P ⟶
             (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj Q)),
          A.Exact ∧ B.Exact ∧
          IsIso (ComposableArrows.app' φ 0) ∧ IsIso (ComposableArrows.app' φ 1) ∧
          IsIso (ComposableArrows.app' φ 3) ∧ IsIso (ComposableArrows.app' φ 4) ∧
          ∀ (j : Set.Ici i) (f : H.obj j),
            b ((ComposableArrows.app' φ 2) (a (d.ι.app j f))) =
              perfectLimitMap R c s j.property (ident j f)
